thread:
laura: Quick idea — can we ship a tiny set of 'mini' deploy templates for common quickflows? preflight + canary + emergency-unwind. saves hand-editing flags every time.

mike: yes pls. I'm tired of copying the same --pin + --grace window combo. :sweat_smile:

sanjay: would like a standard name for them so pinning scripts can reference by alias (eg. mini:canary, mini:dry). easier to audit.

laura: sketch below. minimal syntax so deploy-bot still parses easily. thoughts?

laura: ```
# mini template format (yaml-ish, bot-friendly)
name: mini:canary
steps:
  - preflight: ./scripts/preflight-checks.sh --fast
  - deploy: rgdeploy --model $VER --pin yes --canary 5% --grace 10m
  - monitor: alerts=latency,errors threshold=2% 5m
  - fallback: rgdeploy --rollback --reason "canary-fail"
metadata:
  owner: eng-releases
  change_window: 09:00-18:00
```

olivia: love the small footprint. can we add a bot flag to expand these inline? like `/deploy use mini:canary --expand` to show the resolved commands before run.

mike: deploy-bot should support `--dry` and `--escape-hatch` at the top level. escape-hatch = immediate pin-unwind + notify oncall.

laura: agreed. propose new bot args: `--template NAME`, `--dry`, `--expand`, `--escape-hatch`, `--grace DURATION`

laura: sample quick wrapper for local teams (one-liner):

laura: ```bash
# deploy-mini.sh
T=mini:canary
VER=$1
rgctl bot run --template="$T" --version="$VER" --dry || rgctl bot run --template="$T" --version="$VER"
```

sanjay: nit: make `--grace` optional in template but overridable by CLI. some teams want 0 for low-latency features.

olivia: also add `audit_id` field so release notes generator can pick it up automatically. small mapping to changelog.

laura: good call. adding metadata.audit_id and metadata.notes_url in the sketch.

deploy-bot: Note: I can implement `--template` and `--expand` today as shallow expansion only (no execution) for safety. run `deploy-bot help template` for details.

mike: can we add a short-lint step on config push? CI should reject templates with `fallback` missing.

laura: yep — lint rule and a tiny test harness. I'll open a PR with schema + one example template for canary/dry/unwind.

olivia: sweet. if we standardize these, ops runbooks + release notes become way simpler. :thumbsup:

sanjay: tiny ask — include an escape-hatch cheat sheet in the template comments: exact bot command to run for rollback. helps oncall during stress.

laura: will do. thanks all — i'll draft the PR and tag reviewers.

mike: thanks laura, excited to use the mini templates.
